label: pjm 72 capdel-probe
definition: (PROBE) capdel A/B vs pjm-69 (the PJM keeper at probe time; since superseded by pjm 71 coal-bit): byte-faithful replay of the keeper meta.json + capacity_deliverability_limits=True as the single delta. CONFIRMED structural no-op in the PJM backcast: the Part A seam hook never fired (CETO/CETL are internal LDA limits — no seam import_limit resolves to PJM_external) and Part B gates only evolve_fleet, which the backcast never calls (fleet dispatched as observed). Residual deltas vs the REGISTERED keeper (e.g. 2023 CC_REGULAR -5.7 TWh, 2024 LMP -10.3% vs -10.1%) are main-branch code/data drift since the keeper solved at 4437acd, not the flag — a flag-off arm-A replay on current main is running to confirm byte-identity (PR will carry the final attribution). Forecast-facing Part B root-cause note: the curated PJM 'requirement' is the LDA CETO and 'import_limit' the CETL, so headroom = (in-zone firm + CETL) - CETO screens EVERY filed LDA long (+10 to +42 GW, 2026/27) by construction — the gate degenerates to a PJM-wide capacity-payment collapse (except unfiled West_APS), while PJM's real adequacy test is CETL >= CETO (tight for SWMAAC at 1.02x). The mechanism direction is right; the CETO-as-requirement semantic is misaligned to our zone-total headroom frame. Never a keeper; flag stays default-off.
